common.config_entries.background_scan_co: Maximum number of tracks analysed concurrently during the nightly background scan. Default 1 (serial). Increase only if your hardware can handle concurrent torch/ffmpeg work.
common.config_entries.library_sync_album:
By default, when importing Albums into the library, only the Album itself will be imported into the Music Assistant Library, allowing you to manually browse and select which tracks you want to import. 

If you want to override this default behaviour, you can use this configuration option.

Please note that some (streaming) sources may already define this behaviour unsolicited, by automatically adding all tracks from the album to their library/favourites.
common.config_entries.library_sync_artis: Whether to synchronise (favourited/in-library) Artists from this source to the Music Assistant Library.
Specify the behaviour if an item is manually added to (or removed from) the Music Assistant Library. 
Should we synchronise that action back to the source?

Please note that if you you don't sync back to the source and you have enabled automatic sync/import for this source, a removed item may reappear in the library the next time a sync is performed.
common.config_entries.library_sync_playl:
By default, when importing Playlists into the library, only the Playlist itself will be imported into the Music Assistant Library, allowing you to browse and play the Playlist and optionally add any individual tracks of the Playlist to the Music Assistant Library manually. 

Use this configuration option to override this default behaviour, by specifying the Playlists for which you'd like to import all tracks.
You can either enter the Playlist name (case sensitive) or the Playlist URI.
common.config_entries.play_media_overrid: When this player is currently captured by an active group or sync session, an explicit Play Media command (e.g. starting a new playlist or track from Home Assistant) will release this player from the group/sync and play the new media directly on this player. Disable this to keep the legacy behaviour where Play Media is redirected to the group leader. Other commands (next/prev/pause/resume) are always forwarded to the group leader as they act on the existing playback.
common.config_entries.volume_normalizati: Enable volume normalisation based on the EBU-R128 standard without affecting dynamic range

provider.sonic_analysis.config_entries.c: Number of 7-second windows CLAP analyses per track. More windows produce more representative scalars at linear CPU cost. Thorough is most useful for instrumentalness, where vocals can be missed by a single window.
provider.squeezelite.config_entries.cli_:
Some slimproto based players require the presence of the telnet CLI to request more information. 

By default this CLI is hosted on port 9090 but some players also accept a different port. Set to 0 to disable this functionality.

Commands allowed on this interface are very limited and just enough to satisfy player compatibility, so security risks are minimised to practically zero. You may safely disable this option if you have no players that rely on this feature or you don't care about the additional metadata.
